MetaboReport is an intuitive, web-based platform designed to streamline the exploration, visualization, and statistical analysis of metabolomics data. It offers a structured and user-friendly workflow, making it a flexible tool for users of all levels.

The workflow includes preprocessing (e.g., missing-value imputation, QC-based feature filtering, normalization, transformation, and scaling), univariate and multivariate statistical analyses, and visualization of metabolomics data. To aid interpretation, MetaboReport generates a comprehensive HTML report containing visualizations, tables, summary statistics, and explanatory text (Figure 1).

How to Use MetaboReport

Follow the step-by-step instructions in each page to perform your analysis. For further guidance, read the user manual or explore the included demo data.

1. User Manual

For guidance on preparing an input data table, see the user manual (PDF).

You can also load the built-in demo dataset from the Upload Data page.

2. Demo Data

Use these two demo datasets as references when preparing input data for MetaboReport.

Select Other format when uploading these files on the Upload Data page.

Demo dataset 1 was prepared using Method 1 (see the manual). Peak-area data and metadata are stored in one table: download dataset 1 (CSV).

Demo dataset 2 was prepared using Method 2 (see the manual). Peak-area data and metadata are stored in separate tables: (1) peak-area table (CSV); (2) metadata table (XLSX).
